shared_elements: human figure (frontal/standing in A, small figures in B)
roughly symmetrical paired motifs about a vertical axis
justification: The only overlap is generic: both surfaces carry ring/disc motifs and curved bands arranged with rough bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis, and both involve human forms in some way. Everything specific differs: B shows a narrative scene of a horse with rider approached by a standing figure, dense ribbon-interlace serpents and a patterned marginal border, while A is a monolithic human figure whose back bears only a few sparse, deeply cut rings, spirals and a broad belt-like girdle with no narrative or interlace content at all.
